passages.text: The national June–August 2026 projection lists 25,568,962 people analysed and 1,560,189 estimated in phases 3–5. The phase 5 entry is a dash.
Projection carried forward from October/November 2025; not a March/June 2026 fresh assessment. Phase 5 is printed dash, retained unknown. Geography and population vintage differ from INSTAT/HPC.
